sofi.heightSource: visual canopy apex estimate above local terrain; source building footprint, stadium partly below grade
sofi.geometryDerivation: union of original source stadium body and adjacent ETFE roof-part outlines; see sourceCanopyIds

selection.method: real footprint sample; up to2 source buildings per260m cell in7.5km airport region and25R approach corridor; max1900; excludes source airport boundary and landmarks
selection.contextMethod: curated major road segments and substantial land/beach/water polygons; shorter streets remain visible in actual NAIP imagery, not duplicated as runtime geometry
selection.heightEstimates: unavailable heights use OSM levels×3.2m or6.5/9m visual estimate; not surveyed

imagery.copyright: USDA Farm Service Agency / NAIP2022; public domain with attribution
imagery.processing: Raw RGB bands1,2,3 from source0.6m COG; bilinear reproject/resample; overview source pyramid16x, detail4x; WebP quality89; alpha0 only where no source coverage. Source imagery is2022, not a2026 photograph.

seaMask.processing: Lossless8-bit grayscale. Source polygons and holes transformed to atlas pixel coordinates; ocean conservatively inset0.708pixel before pixel-centre containment, so white pixel cells lie wholly in source water. No photographic colour classification; source geography unchanged.
